summary: Small car park ringed by bush, no homes near, cars parked.

drivers.seclusion: Bush on three sides; only university sheds and labs 6-23 m away, no homes.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed lane enters from the north; bays and aisle have room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Dead-end campus car park; light traffic.
drivers.convention: Two to three cars parked in 2022 and a few in 2025.
